content:
Overview

Bangor is a city in ME with a population of 32,000. Stephen King’s hometown with the Paul Bunyan statue and gateway to Acadia. Housing costs are close to the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5a growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. Reported crime rates are relatively high.
